chat_decision_checkpoint.implementation_context: local Bot API runtime preflight availability without secret disclosure

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
mask=0
if command -v telegram-bot-api >/dev/null 2>&1; then mask=$((mask+1)); fi
if docker images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}' | grep -Eq 'telegram-bot-api|aiogram/telegram-bot-api'; then mask=$((mask+2)); fi
if [ -n "${TELEGRAM_API_ID:-}" ] && [ -n "${TELEGRAM_API_HASH:-}" ]; then mask=$((mask+4)); fi
if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Eq 'createvdobot.*poll|videobot-poll'; then mask=$((mask+8)); fi
if find /mnt/g /mnt/G /home/gace/Project/Gserver -type f -iname '*.mp4' -size +1000M -print -quit 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then mask=$((mask+16)); fi
exit $((100+mask))
